response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), qualifying AS (SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, s.avg_modindex - o.avg_modindex AS above_overall_average FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.avg_modindex) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_overall_average, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying;
